data.name: Vishaal
data.long_meaning: Vishaal means 'Brave, Victorious, Powerful'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vishalah' which means 'wide, extensive, vast' or 'powerful'. It is a strong and powerful name, evoking feelings of courage, strength, and determination.
